supply.note: 100 mA is the stated supply capacity/current budget. Measure circuit current; do not force 100 mA through the circuit. Supply impedance and current-limit behavior are unspecified.

input.frequency_status: proposed default, not a user-specified target

devices.model_status: image-v2 uses a generic NPN proxy for S8050 and illustrative Schottky parameters, not manufacturer-validated models

switch_modes.shunt: Antiparallel Schottky pair returns to ground; signal feeds stage 2 directly.
switch_modes.crossover: Same antiparallel pair inserted in series with the signal feeding stage 2.

gain.note: Define frequency, source versus pedal-input reference, small signal versus large signal gain, and control settings when the schematic is available.

targets.THD_status: Report measured harmonic content without a pass/fail limit.
targets.remaining_specifications: To be supplied when the schematic is made.

analysis_requirements.harmonics: Report H2-H10 relative to fundamental in dBc, fundamental RMS, output DC, and THD through H10; retain waveforms for further analysis.
analysis_requirements.distortion: Compare clipping and harmonic spectrum at fixed controls and input level; additional level sweep points remain to be specified.
analysis_requirements.compressor: Measure steady state input/output curve, gain reduction, attack and release using separate level/envelope tests once their settings are defined.
